requirements.text: ETCS shall provide the driver with information to allow him to drive the train safely.
ETCS shall be able to supervise train and shunting movements.
ETCS shall be functional up to a maximum train speed of 500 km/h.
ETCS shall support application levels 0, 1, 2, 3, and STM.
The current application level shall be indicated on the DMI.
ETCS shall be compatible with existing national train control systems without interference.
ETCS shall support multiple operational states including Full Supervision, Partial Supervision, and Shunting.
ETCS shall be capable of receiving and using National values from trackside.
ETCS shall use harmonized default values if no valid national values are available for the current location.
The onboard equipment shall perform an automatic self-test at start-up.
Train data shall be entered before the on-board ETCS equipment allows train movement.
ETCS shall supervise Shunting operation to a permitted national speed value.
The ETCS trainborne equipment shall be capable of being isolated, disconnecting it from the vehicle braking system.
ETCS shall calculate permitted speed profiles based on infrastructure and train data.
ETCS shall calculate emergency and service braking curves to ensure compliance with speed requirements.
The ETCS trainborne equipment shall be able to determine the location of the entire train.
ETCS shall provide audible and visual warnings to the driver before intervention.
ETCS shall implement roll away and reverse movement protection.
ETCS shall record all data entered, received, or indicated to the driver for investigation and assessment purposes.
ETCS shall support emergency stop commands from the RBC to specific trains or areas.
ETCS shall trigger an emergency brake application if a train passes a stop signal (train trip).
ETCS shall be capable of sending train integrity information to the trackside.
ETCS shall support automatic handover between RBC areas.
ETCS shall provide a warning to the driver at least 5 seconds before intervention.
Override controls for passing stop signals shall be protected against inadvertent operation.
